title: Show remaining todo counts in the HTTPS-only app
description:
Below the list, show how many todos are unfinished as "3 to-dos left", or "1 to-do left" for one. Hide the count when there are no todos at all; when every todo is done, it shows "0 to-dos left". It must update after additions, completing/uncompleting and deletions, and count all unfinished todos regardless of the selected filter.

This repository's server requires HTTPS in both development and production: TLS_KEY and TLS_CERT must point to readable PEM files. Prepare workspace-local development certificates and verify HTTPS startup before validation. Preserve HTTPS-only serving; do not add an HTTP fallback, replace the server with a mock, or commit certificates/private keys. Product QA must use the actual UI and API over HTTPS. No external credentials or user-provided certificates are needed.
